# Android Studio diagnostic fixtures

These three files are copied without byte changes from AOSP tools/adt/idea, revision `a84efec3ba9542d9bfa1255103f0dc94833a3796`, under the Apache License 2.0. Their source paths, upstream links, byte counts and SHA-256 digests are recorded in attribution.json. They are used only to verify that the Sync presentation filter preserves ordinary diagnostics. The original parser, event tree, selection, quick fix and metrics tests remain unported; fixture reuse earns no original test credit.
